Upcoming Events

8 Result(s) Found

Baer Blacksmith Shop Demonstrations

31 Oct 2026 Learn about early Cupertino history, the craft of blacksmithing, and learn from our experienced blacksmith, who will be firing the forge to give demonstrations.

McClellan Ranch Preserve, 22221 McClellan Road,  95014

2 more dates

Tagged as: , Kids & family

Environmental Education Center Open House

31 Oct 2026 Visit our animal ambassadors, engage with preserve staff, learn about the local ecology, and participate in hands-on nature activities.

McClellan Ranch Preserve, 22221 McClellan Road,  95014

8 more dates

Tagged as: , Kids & family

Watershed Habitat of the Steelhead Nature Walk

01 Nov 2026 Join a Naturalist and learn about the Steelhead life cycle, riparian habitat and challenges faced in Stevens Creek. We will walk through history and view our ecosystem through the lens of this phenomenal species. You and your child will identify aquatic insects as a measure of water quality.

McClellan Ranch Preserve, 22221 McClellan Rd,  95014

Tagged as: , Kids & family

Join-A-Ranger: Bird ID and Guided Hike

07 Nov 2026 The Park Rangers invite you to learn about the birds living in our riparian habitat and how to ID them! Walk the trails to see the environment they live in and maybe catch a glimpse of a Red-Shoulder Hawk, Screech Owl, or more! All attendees must register and an adult must accompany children. The hike is approximately one-quarter mile on a combination of dirt trails and paved paths.

McClellan Ranch Preserve, 22221 McClellan Rd,  95014

Tagged as: , Kids & family

Join-A-Ranger: Night Hike and Flashlight Tour

13 Nov 2026 Enjoy a fun-filled Night Hike and Flashlight Tour of McClellan Ranch Preserve and Blackberry Farm! You will explore the woods and nature at night, learn about nocturnal animals' special adaptations, and test our heightened senses in the dark with games and activities.

McClellan Ranch Preserve, 22221 McClellan Rd,  95014

1 more date

Tagged as: , Kids & family

Tree Lighting

04 Dec 2026 Kick off the holiday season at the City’s annual Community Tree Lighting! Experience the moment when the tree comes alive with hundreds of twinkling lights, filling the air with a magical glow.

Quinlan Community Center, 10185 North Stelling Road, Cupertino, CA,  95014
